meta.description: A private Halloween gathering, October 31 to November 1, 2026, in the hills of Lakeway, TX.

hero.title: Beyond the Veil
hero.subtitle: A Halloween Transformation
hero.arrival: Doors 7 PM · Opening ceremony 8:30 PM · Entertainment until sunrise

paragraphs: You have been invited to join us this Halloween for a truly transformational gathering we call Beyond the Veil.
On the 31st of October, as the sun goes down and the veil between worlds thins, a gate will open in the hills of Lakeway to an estate that will become our playground.

For centuries, people have gathered at this time of year to mark the turning from harvest to winter and to honor those who came before. Disguises were worn as a way to walk between worlds, to become someone else for one night and pass unrecognized among the spirits.
This year, we're giving you a permission slip to wear a disguise that does the opposite. Create a costume that celebrates the bigness of your expression.
This event is your canvas, and your gifts are the paint. Be bold, be wild, and play BIG!!
Inside the gates, every expression is honored: your movement, your voice, your dance, and your vibration.
As we move beyond the veil, let the friction fall away, let your “try” die, and let your gifts live.

Everything you need to walk between worlds is below: the flow of the night, inspiration for your costume, and how to get your tickets, rideshare, and parking. Read on, and secure your place before the gate closes.
invitation.closing: See you on the other side,

flow.name: The Arrival
flow.text: Doors open at 7 and close at 8. Check in and find your people.

flow.name: The Crossing
flow.text: The opening ceremony, led by Leah Free, sets the agreements for the whole night. Be there for it.

flow.name: The Night
flow.text: Music in two rooms, with performances and entertainment running all the way to sunrise. At 2 AM the clocks fall back, and Halloween gives us an extra hour.

flow.name: First Light
flow.text: For those still dancing, the final set plays as the sun comes up over the hills.

costume.text: Wear silver, violet, blue, chrome, pearl, or anything that catches the light. Sheer layers, liquid metal, crystal and holographic film all belong here.
costume.layers: Dress in layers you can move in. The night runs from a cool October evening to sunrise, and much of it happens outdoors. Costume shoes may stay on; everyday shoes come off inside the house.
costume.pinterest_text: Looks for every body, pinned for this year.
costume.etsy_text: Pieces we'd wear: headpieces, chrome, sheer layers.

community.caption: Halloween 2025. Every year is a different world, but this is the community you'll be dancing with.

tickets.text: Tickets are released in four tiers, and each tier closes when it sells out. The earliest tier is the lowest price you'll see.

addons.name: Parking pass
addons.text: $50 per car. Very limited; add it at checkout.

addons.name: LoveStack by VESSEL
addons.text: 20% off for guests. Add it at checkout and pick it up when you arrive.

tickets.after: After you buy, you'll receive our Partiful invite. It holds the code to the ticket-holder guide: the address, the rideshare group and parking.

details.name: Alcohol-free
details.text: This is a private, alcohol-free event.

details.name: Doors close at 8 PM
details.text: Arrive by 8 so you're settled for the 8:30 ceremony.

details.name: Getting here
details.text: Rideshare or arrange a drop-off. Parking passes are limited and sold at checkout.

details.name: No road parking
details.text: Cars parked on the road leading in will be towed, and guests who walk in from the road will be turned away.

details.name: Come fed and hydrated
details.text: Water stations will be throughout the property.

details.name: No pets
details.text: Please leave pets at home, and treat the property, art and furnishings with care.

details.name: Consent
details.text: By attending, you agree to honor consent, clear communication and the people around you. Find any member of our team if you need help.

details.name: A curated room
details.text: This is not an open invitation. Every guest is chosen for the safety, depth and chemistry of the room.

nominate.lead: Know someone who belongs on the other side?
nominate.text: Tell us about them. Every nomination is read by our team. A nomination is not an invitation: if your nominee is selected, we'll reach out to them directly, usually within 48 hours.

footer.noshare: This is a private invitation. Please don't post this link publicly.

guide.intro: You're through. Everything you need for the night is here. Please keep it to yourself.

sections.name: Getting here
items: Rideshare or arrange a drop-off. It's the easiest way in and out.
Join the rideshare group to share cars with other guests.
Parking on site is for parking-pass holders only.
Never park on the road leading in. Cars there will be towed, and guests who walk in from the road will be turned away by security.

sections.name: Arrival
items: Doors open at 7 PM and close at 8 PM.
Have your ticket ready on your phone at check-in.
If you added LoveStack by VESSEL at checkout, pick it up at check-in.
The opening ceremony begins outside at 8:30 PM.
There's no re-entry once you're inside.

sections.name: Bring
items: Your costume, and layers you can move in for a cool night outdoors.
Costume shoes may stay on; everyday shoes come off inside the house.

sections.name: Leave at home
items: Alcohol. This is an alcohol-free night.
